changes.title: Bounded shared-memory broadcast waits
changes.note: Adaptive spin commit from local-inference-lab/vllm#800 replayed on top of the prefetch commit; recorded as ce5f4148d4. The upstream pull request later grew to four commits; this lock carries the one the recipe exercises. This base uses FlashInfer's CSF source/block APIs rather than the removed CsfScalePlanes API.

changes.title: Advisory disk row-cache prefetch for Qwen4Exp PLE and DeepSeek V4.1 Engram
changes.note: One switch, VLLM_PLE_PREFETCH=1, warms the host row cache ahead of the lookup through the pinned FlashInfer's DiskTable.prefetch and the ple_hash.host and engram.host row-id helpers.

changes.title: Prometheus metrics for the b12x row cache and prefetch
changes.note: Counters for hits, misses, residency, pool bytes and the prefetch queue, served on /metrics by vllm/v1/metrics/b12x_row_cache.py. The b12x caches are sampled on a daemon thread, never on the step path: reading them inline cost a 14 us median and a 3.6 ms worst case against the prefetch worker's lock, where the published snapshot costs 0.6 us. Totals are reported whether or not VLLM_PLE_PREFETCH is set, because the cache serves synchronous lookups either way.

changes.note: Use intrinsics.reference for NVFP4 and MXFP4 linear weight preparation with the pinned FlashInfer.

changes.title: GB10 DSV4.1 decode split policy and NVFP4 CSF scale defaults
changes.note: The two GB10-specific tips of local-inference-lab/flashinfer's karmic-kraken GB10 line, replayed clean onto auto/lil-main-20261119: 1c0f4c69f selects three DSV4.1 decode splits on the 48-SM GB10 (mla/kernel.py plus test_gb10_dsv41_split_policy.py) and 6d60ad155 enables CSF scale defaults on GB10 for the measured NVFP4 contract (fused_moe/_tuning.py plus test_gb10_nvfp4_csf_defaults.py). The rest of the four b12x-gb10-* branches is superseded: integrate/ds41-reviewed-kernels is contained in b12x-dsv41-gb10-mla-splits, and the compact-csf-inline racing commits patch the pre-October fused_moe tree this pin already moved past.

changes.title: C S3-FIFO host row cache for disk PLE/Engram tables
changes.note: The twelve row-cache commits developed under local-inference-lab/flashinfer#44, replayed clean onto main 598c8547b on auto/lil-main-20261119: the row-cache core, the caller-gated DiskTable.prefetch and host row-id helpers, then the prefetch telemetry commits — requests, rows queued and dropped, jobs, errors, and rows loaded or cancelled only as the worker really published or released them. The upstream pull request later grew beyond these twelve; the lock deliberately carries exactly the audited set. vLLM's prefetch hook and its metrics both need the row-cache commit or later.
